Strings.tunnels.title: Tunnel Manager
Strings.tunnels.subtitle: Manage independent FRP client processes safely
Strings.tunnels.status.ready: Tunnel state is up to date.
Strings.tunnels.status.failed: Tunnel state could not be loaded.
Strings.tunnels.runtime_hint: The server reports the actual runtime state; an absent runtime is never shown as available.
Strings.tunnels.runtime_install_hint: Only a pinned version in the server trust manifest can be installed. A download, verification, or health-check failure never replaces the active version.
Strings.tunnels.runtime_confirm: I confirm installation of this pinned official FRP runtime
Strings.tunnels.runtime_platform_hint: Installation is available only when this OS and architecture have a trusted release entry.
Strings.tunnels.runtime.download_hint: Or download the official archive yourself:
Strings.tunnels.runtime.server_file_hint: Only an official archive that exactly matches the selected version and current platform, and passes verification, is accepted.
Strings.tunnels.runtime.select_server_package: Select an FRP archive on the server
Strings.tunnels.connected_hint: Counted only after FRP logs a successful server login.
Strings.tunnels.saved_hint: Saving Desired State does not start FRP.
Strings.tunnels.overview_hint: Save servers and tunnels on the pages at left, then explicitly apply a server.
Strings.tunnels.safety_hint: Tokens only enter the server-side SecretStore. This UI never reads, echoes, or downloads tokens or TOML.
Strings.tunnels.servers_hint: Each server profile owns an isolated managed frpc process and can connect to self-hosted or third-party frps.
Strings.tunnels.items_hint: This page saves Desired State. Applying its server is what generates controlled configuration and starts frpc.
Strings.tunnels.field.name: Name
Strings.tunnels.token_hint: Leave blank to retain the configured token
Strings.tunnels.token_safety: The token is sent only in a one-way write request; existing values are never displayed.
Strings.tunnels.table.name: Name
Strings.tunnels.logs_live_hint: Refreshes automatically every 2 seconds. You can open several server log windows at once.
Strings.tunnels.logs_hint: Select an FRP server, then retrieve up to 200 sanitized runtime log lines.
Strings.tunnels.frps_hint: Configure and supervise an independent frps process on this host. Tokens and dashboard passwords are write-only and are never displayed or exported.
Strings.tunnels.frps.token_hint: Leave blank to retain the configured token
Strings.tunnels.frps.password_hint: Leave blank to retain the configured password
Strings.tunnels.frps.confirm: I confirm saving and managing this local frps configuration that exposes network ports
